contract.description: Count Unicode code points, not UTF-16 code units. An emoji outside the BMP counts as one; combining marks count separately.
contract.domain: Strings are Unicode text of at most 128 code points. Lone surrogate code units are excluded.
contract.outputRole: Unicode code-point count, not UTF-16 unit count
